kiro-update-checker.checkNow.title: Kiro: Check for Updates Now
kiroUpdateChecker.config.title: Kiro Update Checker Configuration
kiroUpdateChecker.checkInterval.descript: Interval in minutes to check for updates. Set to 0 to disable automatic checks.
kiroUpdateChecker.enableOnStartup.descri: Whether to check for updates on startup.
kiroUpdateChecker.downloadFolder.descrip: Custom folder to download updates to. Leave empty to use the default Downloads folder.
kiroUpdateChecker.packageFormat.descript: Override the package format for downloads. Set to 'auto' for automatic detection based on platform and distribution.
kiroUpdateChecker.update.description: Configure automatic updates. Download fetches new versions in the background; install silently applies them and prompts to restart.
kiroUpdateChecker.update.download.descri: Automatically download new versions when they become available.
kiroUpdateChecker.update.install.descrip: Automatically apply downloaded updates (silent update where supported) and prompt to restart. Requires download to be enabled.
